whyItMatters: hashlib.md5 computes MD5 in python, whose collisions defeat any security reliance on the digest.
actions: Replace hashlib.md5 with hashlib.sha256 wherever the digest protects passwords, signatures, or untrusted data.
For remaining checksum uses, add a comment stating MD5 is intentional and non-security.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified hashlib.md5, and security digests verify under the replacement.
